We got three templates. Need the one that when applied to target yields the three precursors given earlier. The precursors earlier are:

1. C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO
2. C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C
3. C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO

These look like product? Actually these are likely the product after deprotection? Wait target molecule is same as first? Let's compare target: "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO". That's exactly the first precursor. So the target is the first SMILES. The other two are variants where silyl group moved.

Thus the retrosynthetic step likely breaks the C=C double bond formed in HWE, giving aldehyde (phosphonate) and carbonyl? Actually HWE: aldehyde + phosphonate -> alkene + phosphate. So retrosynthesis: target alkene -> aldehyde (or ketone) + phosphonate carbanion (or its precursor). The precursors likely are: aldehyde (maybe O=CH-CH2-...?) and phosphonate ester (e.g., diethyl phosphonate). The three SMILES likely are the product (target) after deprotection variations? Hmm.

But the template we need is the one that generated these three possible precursors from the target. The search result includes template_id 1914389 with mapped_rxn that seems to involve O=[CH]... and a phosphonate CCOP(=O)(OCC)... That matches HWE: aldehyde O=CH-CH2... plus phosphonate diethyl. The mapped_rxn includes product SMILES that looks like our target (with silyl etc). So template_id 1914389 is likely correct.

We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (the integer used to search the database, not hash). So template_id = 1914389, mapped_rxn from result.

Let's extract mapped_rxn string from result. It is:

'O=[CH:8][CH2:7][C@@H:6]1[O:5][C@H:4](/[CH:3]=[C:2](/[CH3:1])[CH2:27][OH:28])[C@H:25]([CH3:26])[C@@H:16]([O:17][Si:18]([CH3:19])([CH3:20])[C:21]([CH3:22])([CH3:23])[CH3:24])[CH2:15]1.CCOP(=O)(OCC)[CH2:9]/[CH:10]=[CH:11]/[C:12](=[O:13])[O:14]CC>>[CH3:1]/[C:2](=[CH:3]/[C@H:4]1[O:5][C@@H:6]([CH2:7]/[CH:8]=[CH:9]/[CH:10]=[CH:11]/[C:12](=[O:13])[OH:14])[CH2:15][C@H:16]([O:17][Si:18]([CH3:19])([CH3:20])[C:21]([CH3:22])([CH3:23])[CH3:24])[C@H:25]1[CH3:26])[CH2:27][OH:28]'
